source.quote: Manchester City and Etihad Airways have the second longest running deal (since 2009). Like Arsenal, this deal also includes stadium naming rights.

source.name: Score and Change – Overview of the 2026/2027 Premier League sponsors
source.quote: Manchester City struck a three-year £55 million deal with crypto exchange firm OKX in 2023, which they have since extended.

summary: Front sponsor Etihad Airways (Abu Dhabi state-owned) since 2009; sleeve sponsor OKX since 2023.
